summary: DEEPKEEP Tresor REST API in api-gateway. Speichert Dateien mit SHA256-Hash in [DEEPKEEP]/data/, verhindert Duplikate via index.json, optionaler Google Drive Upload. EventLog für Store/Retrieve.

endpoints.POST /api/v1/deepkeep/store: content + filename → SHA256 → local file + index entry

decisions: Kein googleapis — Drive API via fetch/crypto built-in
SHA256 Hashing via Node built-in crypto (keine Deps)
Google Drive optional — graceful degradation wenn keine Credentials
